xrds

Panel provides a variety of widgets that can be used to build interactive dashboards. In this notebook, we are going to use some of these widgets. For the complete list of widgets, please see the
Panel documentation
The panel widgets that we are using are:
pn.widgets.Select
for selecting the variable
pn.widgets.DatePicker
for selecting the date
pn.widgets.Player
for making time series animations

w_var = pn.widgets.Select(name="Data Variable", options=list(xrds.data_vars))

    "## Dataset Controls",
    w_var,
)
dataset_controls
Now, let’s create dropdown widgets for selecting the colormap and plot type.

w_cmap = pn.widgets.Select(name="Colormap", options=["inferno", "plasma", "coolwarm"])


w_plot_type = pn.widgets.Select(
    name="Plot Type", options=["Color Plot", "Contour"]
)


plot_controls = pn.WidgetBox(
    "## Plot Controls",
    w_plot_type,
    w_cmap,
)
plot_controls
Now, let’s put together all the controls and the plot in a panel layout using
pn.Row
and
pn.Column

controls = pn.Column(dataset_controls, plot_controls)
controls
